 preliminary medical test. The same applies to personnel responsible for 
 guiding crane movements by means of signals to the operators.

It is inhibited to employ personal below the age of

The legal and regulator prescription for equipment 
 safety.
The dangers inherent to crane utilization.

The precautions to be observed before, during and 
 after utilization and / or intervention on the crane, may it be normal or

 to working personnel during the course of their duty, thus ensuring them with 
 maximum safety during utilization and/or intervention on the crane, may it be 
 normal or exceptional.
